---
title: "Open-sourcing the MIDSEA validation notebooks"
date: 2026-02-11
categories: [Tooling]
description: "A shared suite to check whether your compartmental model does what the paper says it does."
---

We are releasing the MIDSEA validation notebook suite as open-source software. This collection of Jupyter and Quarto notebooks provides standardised checks for compartmental models, helping researchers verify that their implementations match published specifications.
